podcast.body: Featured on the *Grease* soundtrack, this song became Olivia Newton-John's next country hit after 1975, demonstrating her continued crossover appeal. "If I told you that it was a song on the Greece soundtrack, I bet then you'd remember what the song was. That's right. It was hopelessly devoted to you."

Olivia Newton-John performed "Hopelessly Devoted to You," a song from the 1978 movie *Grease*. This song was a contender for Best Original Song at the Academy Awards in 1978. "they had hopelessly devoted to you by Olivia Newton-John from Greece".

Olivia Newton-John's only solo contribution to the *Grease* soundtrack. Written by her long-time producer John Farrar, the song was not originally intended for the movie but was included due to her contract requiring a solo song. Farrar reportedly spent a significant amount of time perfecting the lyrics. It achieved number three on the Billboard Hot 100, number one globally in several places, and number 20 on the country charts, also receiving an Oscar nomination, though it lost to Donna Summer's "Last Dance." "Hopelessly devoted to you."

This solo song from Olivia Newton-John, featured in *Grease*, was another chart success, appearing at number five on Record World's top singles on September 23, 1978. "Followed by Hopelessly Devoted to You by Olivia Newton-John at number five."
